title: Privacy: a fresh install does not listen on the network; LAN is the opt-in
covers: Default network mode Off, no firewall prompt before LAN, Network widget facts
context: A new install keeps the lobby server on this computer only. Nothing listens on the network and Windows shows no firewall alert at the first launch. The alert can only come when you choose LAN in Where, press Run and answer Open to my network. The reach facts are now in the Network widget.
changed: lobby server default network mode Off

setup.label: state
setup.text: Close Archipelia. If .user-data\Data\server\listener.json exists in the bundle-4 worktree, rename it to listener-keep.json so the first launch state returns.

setup.label: firewall
setup.text: If you allowed this Electron app in Windows Defender Firewall before, Windows will not ask again. Remove its rule first to see the alert.

setup.label: game
setup.text: A Link to the Past installed: Library, Games, tab Built-in, press Add on its card.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

steps: Launch with the command of this test. If the welcome tour opens, press Skip. Let Home sit for about 30 seconds. No Windows Security Alert about a firewall appears.
In the sidebar, under Hosting, open Servers, tab Archipelia servers, This The status reads Listening and Network mode shows A line reads Lobby address Press it.

The Network widget shows the facts: Lobby address 127.0.0.1, Network mode Off, Seen on your network No, the mode is Off, Router port Not asked for in this mode, TLS. The line This launch is automated shows nowhere.
In PowerShell run Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort and the port number. Every line shows LocalAddress 127.0.0.1 and none shows 0.0.0.0.

Open Sessions, New session, name it Privacy check, add a player Host1, turn on Allow direct connections, leave Where on Local and press The tab opens and still no firewall alert shows The PowerShell command still lists 1.
Close the tab. In Sessions choose LAN in Where, press Save and run. The question Open this computer to your network? appears first. Press Keep it private. Nothing changes, no alert shows.
Press Run and then Open to my network. Only now Windows may show its firewall alert. The tab opens and the Network widget says This computer is open to your network.
Press Stop in the Network widget. Servers, Archipelia servers, This computer shows Network mode Off again. Run the PowerShell command again: only 127.0.0.1 is listed.
pass: No firewall alert at the first launch, with Network mode Off and only 127.0.0.1 listening.
A Local session with direct connections opens nothing to the network.
The LAN question comes at Run, before any alert, and Keep it private changes nothing.
The Network widget shows the facts and Stop returns the mode to Off.
fail: A firewall alert appears at launch or when direct connections are turned on.
Any 0.0.0.0 or LAN address listens while Network mode is Off.
notes: If listener.json was renamed, delete the new one and rename listener-keep.json back when you are done. Optional.
Discovery is separate: it only listens while Join a session is looking for servers.
This is a visible user launch, so the line This launch is automated must not show.
